meeting_point: 1 Father Junipero Serra Trail, San Diego, CA 92119
description: During this guided tour, participants will receive a transformative experience immersed in nature.
what_is_included:
The tour includes a calming guided meditation led by an experienced teacher, and a hike up a beautiful mountain surrounded by real sage plants to cleanse inner chaos. Lastly, participants will embark on a quiet nature walk to release inner pain to Mother Nature, leaving them feeling rejuvenated and refreshed.

*A fully equipped light backpack
*Bottled water
*Hand Sanitizer
*Blank Notepad and Pen
*Experienced Guide
itinerary:
1. Meditation Session
2. Journal Session (optional)
3. Nature Pictures taken by the guide (optional)
4. Hike up the mountain
5. Adventure down the mountain (different route)
6. Nature walk and release of energy
check_in_details: Meeting Instructions: We will meet near the visitor center ENTRANCE, not the actual visitor center. Your tour guide will be wearing a white hoodie, top, or shirt. Please feel free to contact us at 619-464-9210 or info@frequencytours.com
restrictions:
*Not recommended for travelers with back problems
*Not recommended for pregnant travelers
*Not recommended for travelers with heart problems or other serious medical conditions
disclaimers: Frequency Tours holds no responsibility for any physical injury. Each participant understands the hiking/nature portion of the tour could involve inherent risks like any nature activity and Frequency Tours is not liable for any outcomes.
